title: Landing page: Thank you (demo booked)
seoDescription: Schedule a 15-minute discovery call with our product experts to assess how DataChannel can partner with you.

blocks.title: Thank You for Booking a Demo with DataChannel! 🎉
blocks.subtitle: We’ve reserved your slot. You’ll receive a confirmation email shortly with the meeting details.

items.title: To Make the Most of Your Demo
items.body:
- Be ready to share your current data integration challenges or workflows.
- Feel free to invite one or more team members from Data / Analytics / Engineering who work closely with ETL pipelines.
- Ensure you have access to your data sources (e.g., databases, SaaS apps) you’d like to connect.
